header.title: Accessibility Modes
header.subtitle: Use /echoscreencore accessibility commands to compare rendering

card.title: Large Text
card.text: Font and spacing tokens scale up. Button height and row spacing should prevent overlap.

card.title: High Contrast
card.text: Text and borders become stronger while markup stays the same.

card.title: Reduced Clutter
card.text: Glow and decorative noise are suppressed by the render bridge and style resolver.

card.title: Compact Density
card.text: Spacing contracts for dense operational screens.

card.title: Comfortable Density
card.text: Spacing expands for guided screens and longer reading sessions.
